en: A black-and-white multi-view postcard with three landscape photographs from a spa town. The top image shows a calm lake surrounded by forested hills with small boats at a dock, labeled "Gondelteich." The middle image is a panoramic view over a green valley with a clustered town and church spire, framed by trees, and the central caption reads "Bad Elster." The bottom image shows a formal spa complex with colonnades, flower beds, paths, benches, and a large main building in the background, labeled "Badeplatz."
